agent.reasons: The entity is in Vietnam (VN), and so is its 67% owner and control person, Yusuf Zhou. Vietnam is on FATF's increased-monitoring list, which requires escalation to EDD under 6.2. Two other problems would each require requesting documents. First, ownership is incomplete under 3.3: nobody knows who owns Ember Holdings LLC, which holds 33%. Second, the registry filing dated 2025-06-16 is more than 12 months old under 3.5. Under 2.1, escalation outranks requesting documents.
still_needed: Confirmation that Vietnam is still on FATF's increased-monitoring list on 2026-10-27
Beneficial owners of Ember Holdings LLC (33% holder), including who controls it
A current registry filing less than 12 months old
